summary: Make the native recovery repair path a strict no-op when Tier0 and Slack are already healthy.
reason: Network callbacks can occur during normal operation; healthy callbacks must not spawn redundant Tier0 bootstrap attempts.

tests.name: native-recovery-targeted
tests.evidence: Updated unit suite covers healthy no-op and degraded bounded repair; final run recorded before publication.

capabilities.reason: Operational idempotence only; capability scope and failure-domain ownership are unchanged.

architecture.reason: Refines the existing deterministic entrypoint; no new component or owner.

rollback: Revert this maintenance commit and promote the previous native-recovery release if required.
limitations: Does not change V1 trigger coverage; FCM/cloud wake remains a separate follow-up.
